mechanism_narrative: An annualized inflation rate above 3.5% (computed from CPIAUCSL) signals a high-inflation environment, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate market reactions to inflation data.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL annualized inflation rate > 3.5%, the 5-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of instances (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy, which increases the cost of capital and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of instances (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an economic contraction and tightening monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in the past 3 months
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in the past 3 months, the 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1400 thousand units and consumer spending (RSAFS) exceed 700,000 million dollars, the economy is in a late-cycle expansion regime, which is characterized by overvaluation and impending monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1400 and RSAFS > 700000, the 60-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signals a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO declines by at least 0.5% over the past 3 months, the 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 4.5% signals an economic slowdown, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.5%, the 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals robust economic demand, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 0.5% and RSAFS rises > 0.3% in the past 3 months
failure_condition: When HOUST rises > 0.5% and RSAFS rises > 0.3% in the past 3 months, the 20-day forward returns are not positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past 3 months signals an economic contraction, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 declines by at least 0.5% over the past 3 months, the 60-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of instances.
